steps.title: Read OpenCV measurements
steps.detail: OpenCV 5.0.0 measured hi-vis coverage 6.8% across 1 orange contours, 1 panel-shaped regions, and 1 yellow or red placard regions.

steps.title: Measure the panel interior
steps.detail: Interior edge density is 1.5%, below the 8% open-gear threshold. The cover is treated as latched.

steps.title: Check the jobsite policy
steps.detail: Vest, cover, and label all pass. Next action is a short all-clear SMS. ticket.create will be skipped.

steps.title: Open an urgent office ticket
steps.detail: Policy returned CLEAR, so no office ticket is opened.

steps.title: Draft the text
steps.detail: Drafted a CLEAR text to office. The wording comes from the policy branch, not a fixed script.

output.body: FieldSight CLEAR on the HVAC call (INS-670A9D29). Hi-vis vest is in frame, the panel cover reads latched, and a warning label is beside the gear. Crew can keep working.

steps.title: Write the clearance note
steps.detail: The note records the measurements and which tools the branch actually ran.

output.note:
FIELDSIGHT CLEARANCE NOTE
Inspection: INS-670A9D29
Trade: HVAC
Decision: CLEAR
Image: s3://fieldsight-local/inspections/8910d4d2cc8f1747.png
Storage: local-mock

OpenCV 5.0.0
- Hi-vis coverage: 6.8% (threshold 4%) → present
- Panel: closed, interior edge density 1.5% (open at 8%)
- Warning label beside equipment: yes

Tools run: vision.read, panel.measure, policy.check, sms.draft
Tools skipped: ticket.create
Ticket: none

Release: crew may continue this task.

Photo heuristic for the crew. A qualified person still has to confirm the equipment before anyone works it.
